title: Warning Bar
description: 純 CSS 斜紋進度條。條紋底圖寬度用 sin() 從角度與週期算出來，動畫剛好移動一格底圖，循環時不會跳、交界也對得上；顏色變體只換 CSS 變數。
descriptionEn: A pure-CSS striped progress bar. The stripe tile width is computed from the angle and period with sin(), and the animation moves exactly one tile so the loop never jumps; color variants only swap CSS variables.
author: Antonio
